experiment_data.hypothesis: Adding BEV occupancy auxiliary supervision (with gradient flow to vision encoder via occ_detach=false) during OpenVLA-OFT fine-tuning on LIBERO-Spatial will significantly improve collision avoidance rate (CAR) on SafeLIBERO Level I compared to vanilla baseline, by forcing the vision encoder to develop spatial awareness of 3D object boundaries
